sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is semantically supported because none represents a per-craft relationship for a location-signal device or an on-scene transmit/receive device.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the per-craft model: the candidate enforces only a distress-alert device and omits the required location-signal and on-scene transmit/receive devices. Locate canonical per-craft relationships for those two device roles (and a rescue-boat class/combined craft class if required), then require every released rescue boat and lifeboat to have at least one device of each of all three roles.
